entry.content:
Race Condition / TOCTOU: Discovered a concurrency flaw in group-member management where simultaneous state-changing requests could leave a group member in an inconsistent state, making the member undeletable through normal functionality.

entry.title: How I Approach Web Application Penetration Testing: Beyond the Scanner
entry.content:
A practical guide to my approach to web application penetration testing—from understanding the application and mapping its attack surface to testing authentication, authorization, APIs, business logic, and vulnerability chains. The blog focuses on using automated tools for coverage while relying on manual analysis and attacker-focused thinking to identify weaknesses that scanners can miss, validate their real-world impact, and produce clear, actionable security reports.
